items.name: utils
items.title: cn() and variants
items.description: Class name merging (clsx + tailwind-merge, aware of the SAP token utilities) and cva variants.

items.name: theme
items.title: SAP Horizon theme
items.description: SAP theme tokens for Tailwind v4: Horizon, Horizon Dark, Horizon HC Black and Horizon HC White, the 72 and SAP icon fonts, density and state variants.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Icons from the SAP-icons, SAP-icons-TNT and Business Suite fonts.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Buttons in every SAP type, with glyphs, menu arrow, toggled and selected states, badges and semantic descriptions for screen readers. On Base UI's Button.

items.name: title
items.title: Title
items.description: Headings with the SAP header typography; the visual size can differ from the heading level.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Links in the standard, emphasized, subtle, undecorated, inverted and disabled styles, with icons and a touch target size.

items.name: busy-indicator
items.title: Busy Indicator
items.description: Three pulsing dots that show loading; wraps content to cover it and make it inert while loading.

items.name: action-bar
items.title: Action Bar
items.description: The header of a page with a back button, title, description and page actions.

items.name: layout-grid
items.title: Layout Grid
items.description: A responsive 12-column grid with gutters, spans and offsets per breakpoint (600, 1024 and 1440px), growing columns and nesting.

items.name: counter
items.title: Counter
items.description: A small badge with a number, such as unread items, inline with text or as a notification on an icon.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with a label, value states, read-only and display-only modes, and an optional selectable third state.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line and multi-line text fields with value states, read-only and disabled styles, and a character counter. On Base UI's Input.

items.name: layout-panel
items.title: Layout Panel
items.description: A rounded content container with a header (title, description, actions), filters, a body that can bleed to the edges and an aligned footer.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Content in an overlay next to its trigger, with placements, an optional arrow, header and footer, on Base UI's Popover.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Radio buttons in a radio group, with value states, read-only and disabled modes, and an inline layout.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch on Base UI's Switch, with semantic accept/decline colours, short on/off texts and a clickable label.

items.name: info-label
items.title: Info Label
items.description: A small non-interactive coloured label for a status, category or count, with an optional icon, ten accent colours and a display size.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: An image, initials or an icon for a person or object, with accent colours, zoom and value state badges, and image fallbacks. On Base UI's Avatar.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: List with standard, byline and subline items, secondary texts, icons, links, checkbox and radio selection, group headers, footers and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: object-status
items.title: Object Status
items.description: The status of an object in semantic or generic indication colours, with an optional icon, as text, an inverted badge or a clickable button, in regular and large sizes.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A hierarchy of items that expand and collapse, with keyboard navigation, highlights, navigatable items, single and multiple selection and lazily loaded data.

items.name: bar
items.title: Bar
items.description: A horizontal container for titles and actions in left, middle and right areas, used as the header, subheader or footer of pages, dialogs and popovers.

items.name: message-strip
items.title: Message Strip
items.description: Inline messages coloured by type or indication colour, dismissible or dismissing themselves after a delay, and alerts at the edges of the screen.

items.name: tile
items.title: Tile
items.description: Launch, KPI, feed, slide and line (link) tiles of the SAP Fiori launchpad, in regular and small sizes and double width, with numeric content and an action mode.

items.name: segmented-button
items.title: Segmented Button
items.description: A group of buttons of which one, or several with toggle, is selected, on Base UI's ToggleGroup, with roving focus and a vertical layout.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window with a header, body and footer that can be draggable, resizable, full screen and mobile, opened from a trigger or from code, on Base UI's Dialog.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A shimmering placeholder shaped like content that is still loading: a rectangle, a circle, text lines or custom SVG shapes.

items.name: token
items.title: Token
items.description: Removable tokens for chosen values, and a tokenizer that shares one field with an input, with keyboard selection and removal and an overflow popover.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: A field with an input and text, icon or button addons before or after it, as one control or composed from parts, with value states, read-only and disabled styles. On Base UI's Input.

items.name: message-box
items.title: Message Box
items.description: A modal alert dialog for errors, warnings, successes, information and confirmations, with a semantic header line and icon, declared in a Dialog or opened from code.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Form building blocks: header, fieldset and legend, groups, items, labels with required and colon markers, and value state messages in a popover under their field, on Base UI.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: A search field with clear and search buttons that suggests matching entries while typing, with value states, on Base UI's Autocomplete.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A list of actions in a popover opened by a trigger, with submenus, icons, shortcuts, toggles, single-choice groups, inputs and a mobile mode in a dialog, on Base UI's Menu.

items.name: datetime
items.title: Datetime
items.description: Date and time adapter (FdDate and an Intl based default), display and parse formats, React contexts and hooks for them, and format functions for the calendar, time and the pickers.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Calendar picking a date, several dates, a range or several ranges, with month, year and years range views, week numbers, special days with a legend, and keyboard navigation across months.

items.name: message-page
items.title: Message Page
items.description: A full-page message when there is nothing to show, such as no items, no search or filter results or an error, with an icon, a title, a subtitle and actions announced as a polite status.

items.name: time
items.title: Time
items.description: Time picking hours, minutes, seconds and the period in spinbutton columns, changed with the arrow keys, the mouse wheel, dragging, typing and spinner buttons.

items.name: step-input
items.title: Step Input
items.description: A number field with decrement and increment buttons that repeat while pressed, formatted for the locale as a decimal or a currency.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A field that opens a list of options, with value state messages, keyboard selection and typeahead, and a mobile dialog mode, on Base UI's Select.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Date field with a button that opens a calendar in a popover (or a dialog on mobile), for a date, several dates, a range or several ranges, with typed dates, validation, value states and a today button.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: An input that suggests values from a list while typing, with inline completion, groups, item templates, value states and a mobile dialog, on Base UI's Combobox.

items.name: nested-list
items.title: Nested List
items.description: A tree of navigation items with groups, headers, icons and expandable children, and a condensed mode whose children open in a popover.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: A time field with a button that opens the time columns in a popover; typed times are read on Enter and blur, unreadable ones set the error state, with value state messages.

items.name: multi-input
items.title: Multi Input
items.description: A tokenizer field with a filterable list of check box options, inline completion, new tokens and a mobile dialog with select all.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Previous and next buttons, page numbers with ellipses or a page input, an optional items per page select and the number of results, as one keyboard tab stop.

items.name: action-sheet
items.title: Action Sheet
items.description: A menu of actions for the control that opens it, in a popover or, on phones, in a sheet at the bottom of the screen with a title bar.

items.name: scroll-spy
items.title: Scroll Spy
items.description: A scroll container and a hook that report which tracked child is at the top, e.g. to highlight the current entry of a table of contents.

items.name: overflow-layout
items.title: Overflow Layout
items.description: Single-row layout that moves the items that do not fit into a "N more" popover.

items.name: wizard
items.title: Wizard
items.description: Breaks a long task into steps: a progress bar of steps over the content of the visited steps, which scrolls and updates the current step, with stacking steps on narrow screens.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tab bar with panels, counts, value states, icon-only, process and filter modes, a "More" menu for tabs that do not fit, and stacked content that follows the scrolling.

items.name: side-navigation
items.title: Side Navigation
items.description: A navigation column with main and utility nested lists, arrow-key navigation across both and a condensed mode with icons only.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Navigation trail from the root to the current page, with the items that do not fit collapsed into a menu at the start.

items.name: shellbar
items.title: Shellbar
items.description: The top bar of an application: branding, context area, search, actions with an overflow menu, user menu and product switch, adapting to its width.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of actions with an optional title that moves the items that do not fit into an overflow popover, by priority and group.

items.name: message-toast
items.title: Message Toast
items.description: A short message that disappears by itself, opened from code with a service and stacked at a screen edge or next to an element.

items.name: inline-help
items.title: Inline Help
items.description: Help text in a small popover with an arrow that opens on hover and focus of its trigger (a question-mark icon by default) and describes the trigger for screen readers, on Base UI's Tooltip.

items.name: product-switch
items.title: Product Switch
items.description: A grid button that opens the products of the user in a popover: a grid of two to four columns or a list, reorderable by drag and drop, with arrow key navigation.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: A main action and an arrow that opens a menu of alternative actions, where the chosen action becomes the main one, on the registry's Button and Menu (Base UI's Menu).

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User Menu
items.description: The signed-in user's name, details and actions in a popover opened from an avatar, with submenus and a full-screen mobile mode.

items.name: object-identifier
items.title: Object Identifier
items.description: The key identifier of an object as a title, optionally bold or a link, with a description below, in large or medium size.

items.name: object-marker
items.title: Object Marker
items.description: A technical status of an object, such as draft, locked or favourite, as an icon, text or both, optionally a clickable link.

items.name: object-number
items.title: Object Number
items.description: A number formatted for the locale with its unit, coloured by value state, optionally emphasized, large, an inverted badge or an interactive button.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A container for one topic: a header with title, subtitle, avatar, counter and KPI, content, footer actions, badges, media and banners, with interactive cards in an arrow-key card list.

items.name: object-attribute
items.title: Object Attribute
items.description: A single-line property of an object, its label and value truncated with an ellipsis, optionally with an action link.

items.name: generic-tag
items.title: Generic Tag
items.description: A key figure of an object, a name and a value with an optional status, shown as a focusable button in object page headers.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: A paragraph of text with an optional line limit, a More/Less toggle, preserved whitespace and hyphenation.

items.name: illustrated-message
items.title: Illustrated Message
items.description: An SAP illustration with a title, a text and actions for empty states and errors, in scene, dialog, spot, dot and text-only sizes or responsive to its width.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: A container with a title bar whose content expands and collapses with an arrow button, or is always shown when fixed.

items.name: scrollbar
items.title: Scrollbar
items.description: A scroll container with SAP-themed scrollbars, either direction of which can be turned off or kept always visible.

items.name: infinite-scroll
items.title: Infinite Scroll
items.description: A scroll container and a hook that call back when the content is scrolled near its end, e.g. to load more list items.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: Status Indicator
items.description: An SVG shape, or a set of shapes, filled to a percentage linearly, at an angle or radially and coloured by status, announced as a progress bar.

items.name: progress-indicator
items.title: Progress Indicator
items.description: A bar that shows the progress of a task, with its value or a text above it, an icon for a value state, and a popover for a truncated text.

items.name: formatted-text
items.title: Formatted Text
items.description: Renders a sanitised subset of HTML (paragraphs, headings, lists, emphasis, links, code) with the SAP typography, optionally in a fixed-size scrolling box.

items.name: quick-view
items.title: Quick View
items.description: A short overview of a person, an object or a company in a popover or dialog: a header, a subheader with an avatar and groups of label-value pairs.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Avatars of a team, each with its own details popover or overlapping in one group button, with the avatars that do not fit in a "+N" overflow popover.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Slider on Base UI's Slider for a number, a range or custom values, with ticks, labels, a vertical layout and read-only or editable tooltips.

items.name: rating-indicator
items.title: Rating Indicator
items.description: Star rating as a slider, with half values, display mode, custom icons, sizes and the votes per rating in a popover.

items.name: datetime-picker
items.title: Datetime Picker
items.description: Date and time field with a button that opens a calendar and time columns in a popover (or a dialog on mobile), applied with OK or at once, with typed values, validation and value states.

items.name: vertical-navigation
items.title: Vertical Navigation
items.description: The side navigation of SAP Fiori: items with icons, texts and second-level items, an indicator for the current page and a condensed mode that opens second-level items in a panel.

items.name: dynamic-page
items.title: Dynamic Page
items.description: A page with a title area, a header that collapses on click or scroll and can be pinned, optional tabs, scrolling content and a footer, with paddings that follow its width.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Posts in chronological order along a vertical or horizontal line, on one side or alternating on both sides, with loading placeholders.
